findings.title: Button loses right alignment after .small-action becomes flex
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container via `@include flexbox()`, so its direct `button` child is a flex item and the `float: right` declaration is ignored. With default `justify-content: flex-start` and no `margin-left: auto` on the button, the button is laid out immediately after `.small-action-desc` instead of on the right. Add `margin-left: auto` (or otherwise justify the item) to preserve the previous right alignment.

findings.title: align-items mixin missing -moz-box-align for legacy Firefox
findings.body: The `flexbox()` mixin emits `display: -moz-box`, so old Firefox builds that use it expect alignment through `-moz-box-align`, but `align-items()` only emits `-webkit-box-align`, `-ms-flex-align`, and the modern properties. In those browsers this change silently fails to center/baseline-align flex items. Add `-moz-box-align: $alignment` alongside `-webkit-box-align`.
